schema_transition.evidence: Reviewed single-step transition from the installed through-021 lineage (021 applied 2026-10-28, apply run 40654201809) to through-021-022, preserving installed order and byte hashes under the exact-prefix gate. Pending set: [022]. Migration 022 owns its BEGIN/COMMIT and its ledger row commits atomically. Production copy-economy-opportunity runs 41140926027 and 41155213939 slowed from 2.92 s to 6.85 s per 100,000-row chunk: 019's chunk read and 021's verification re-read paired a row comparison led by derived_generation_id with a separate equality, so every chunk's btree scan started at the first survivor index entry and the economy_opportunity verification could never fit its 19,200 s bound. 022's v3_meta.purge_copy_keyset bounds the generation with <= so the row comparison is the scan's start key (the same rows, the same plan shape); purge_copy_chunk (019's) and purge_copy_verify (021's) use it and change nothing else. 016's purge_assert_request also accepts the live ledger minus exactly 022's own row, because the purge authorized on 2026-10-29 (run 40971335172) froze the through-021 ledger; any other ledger difference still refuses. Otherwise 016's, 019's and 021's checks, settings, owners and grants. Installation copies, swaps, drops and deletes no payload row and changes no table, view, grant or ledger row. scripts/operator/v3_schema_identity.py reproduces installed checksum c54f861f1dfac64cad9e543da47fe709492c2ad1f468f86f44dd706fa1d40679 and target checksum c58e73a572dc24bb920c3cc595089460ccaaa44024de07ea3a73bdff87fe891f with migration-set identity sha256:828bf02d263d7ab27b3764cbfa3457859aeb229ccf16cb9929d586136f8e83d7. Accepted 1e748c9d and its rollback targets are compatible with both endpoints. Governed apply refuses while any copy is staged or swapped, so the partial economy_opportunity copy is abandoned before 022 is applied. Registration only: exact-head acceptance, a reviewed governed plan and a separate apply remain required.
